states.claim: profile is the EXIF StringInfo obtained from the image profile; NULL if absent.
states.evidence:
L440: profile=GetImageProfile(image,"exif");
L441: if (profile == (const StringInfo *) NULL)

states.claim: exif points to the byte storage of the EXIF profile datum.
directory points into the exif byte storage at the first IFD offset.
directory_stack entries hold saved directory pointers, entry indices, and tag offsets; popping restores directory, entry, and tag_offset from the stack.
q points into the exif byte storage at the current directory entry.
p points into the exif byte storage at the tag value location, either inline within the directory entry or at an offset into the exif storage.
p1 is initialized from p and advanced by size per component, preserving provenance to the exif storage region.
value is a heap-allocated string produced by AcquireString or AcquireQuantumMemory, or NULL if allocation fails.
states.evidence:
L46: value=AcquireString(buffer); \
L72: value=AcquireString(buffer); \
L663: value=(char *) AcquireQuantumMemory((size_t) number_bytes+1UL,
L737: value=(char *) AcquireQuantumMemory((size_t) number_bytes+1UL,

states.claim: value is released with DestroyString after being used.
key is a heap-allocated string produced by AcquireString and released with DestroyString.
exif_resources is a SplayTree allocated by NewSplayTree and later destroyed.
states.evidence:
L576: exif_resources=NewSplayTree((int (*)(const void *,const void *)) NULL,
L869: exif_resources=DestroySplayTree(exif_resources);

states.claim: directory_stack entries are written with the current directory, incremented entry, and tag_offset before descending into a sub-IFD.
directory_stack entries are written with directory pointers derived from exif plus an offset for sub-IFD and next-IFD traversal.

values.claim: directory_stack has MaxDirectoryStack (16) elements; level is bounded below MaxDirectoryStack-2 before pushing entries, so directory_stack[level] accesses stay within the array.
values.evidence:

L406: directory_stack[MaxDirectoryStack];
L828: if (((size_t) offset < length) && (level < (MaxDirectoryStack-2)))
L857: (level < (MaxDirectoryStack-2)))

values.claim: tag_bytes[] has 13 elements indexed by format; format is checked < sizeof(tag_bytes)/sizeof(*tag_bytes) and != 0 before use. number_bytes = components * tag_bytes[format], with components >= 0 and overflow check number_bytes < components.
q = directory + 12*entry + 2; q is checked against exif+length-12 before reading 12-byte directory entries.

values.claim: If number_bytes <= 4, p = q+8 (inline value); otherwise p = exif+dir_offset after checking dir_offset >= 0, dir_offset < length, and dir_offset+number_bytes <= length without overflow.
Before formatting, p is checked to lie in [exif, exif+length-tag_bytes[format]].

values.claim: The first IFD offset is read as a signed long; it is rejected if negative or >= length, then directory = exif+offset.
directory is checked to lie in [exif, exif+length-2] before reading the entry count.
values.evidence:

L595: number_entries=(size_t) ReadPropertyUnsignedShort(endian,directory);

values.claim: For EXIF/GPS/Interop offset tags, offset is read from p; if offset >= 0 and < length and level < MaxDirectoryStack-2, directory_stack[level] is set to exif+offset.

The next-IFD offset is read from directory+2+12*number_entries only after checking that address is <= exif+length; if nonzero, < length, and level < MaxDirectoryStack-2, directory_stack[level] is set to exif+offset.
For '#'/'@' tag parsing, n = strlen(property) must equal 4; n/=4 makes n=1, and the loop shifts tag left by 4 and ORs in each parsed hex digit.
tag is initialized to ~0UL and must be changed before use; tag_value is computed as ReadPropertyUnsignedShort(endian,q)+tag_offset.
length = GetStringInfoLength(profile); parsing requires length >= 6 initially and length >= 16 after locating the EXIF header.
The EXIF header scan advances exif and decrements length via ReadPropertyByte until the 6-byte 'Exif\0\0' sequence is found or length becomes 0.

L541: if (ReadPropertyByte(&exif,&length) != 0x66)

L545: if (ReadPropertyByte(&exif,&length) != 0x00)

values.claim: id is read as a signed short at exif; id == 0x4949 selects LSBEndian, id == 0x4D4D selects MSBEndian, otherwise parsing fails.
tag_offset is added to each entry tag to form tag_value; tag_offset1 is 0x10000 for GPS offset tags and 0 otherwise.
The value-formatting block is entered only when all != 0 or tag == tag_value.
values.evidence: L646: if ((all != 0) || (tag == (size_t) tag_value))

values.claim: For all==2, key formatting uses tag_value ranges: < 0x10000 as '#%04lx', < 0x20000 as '@%04lx' with tag_value & 0xffff, otherwise 'unknown'.
